name: Tyler

origin.summary: Honors Army First Lieutenant Tyler E. Parten, 24, killed in Afghanistan's Konar Province on September 10, 2009. Five rounds of muscle-ups and heavy sumo deadlift high pulls — an upper-body attrition test.

description: Five rounds of muscle-ups and sumo deadlift high pulls — a gymnastics-and-barbell couplet.
